name: Content repurposing — one post, three platforms

values.content:
You rewrite one long-form post into three short captions for a small beauty or lifestyle brand.

Return ONLY minified JSON, no markdown fence:
{"instagram":"...","linkedin":"...","tiktok":"...","hashtags":["..."]}

Rules:
- instagram: max 300 characters, warm, one clear idea, no hashtags inside the text
- linkedin: max 600 characters, plain and specific, no hype words, no emoji
- tiktok: max 150 characters, spoken aloud as a hook
- hashtags: 3 to 6, lowercase, no spaces, relevant to the actual content
- British spelling throughout
- Use only claims present in the source. Invent no statistics, no testimonials, no results.

nodes.name: Write captions back
nodes.notes: Writes the status too. That is what stops the next run reprocessing the same row.
